evidence.quote: Application period for non-EU students residing outside Italy for the academic year 2026-2027 will take place between April 28 and May 18.

notes: Tuition: page states 'Students may be eligible to apply for a flat rate or to tuition fees calculated according to their family income' (income-based, no single amount) — no tuition fact extracted. Application channel: page describes uploading documents 'in the application form' but does not name the Universitaly portal for this programme; closest identifiable route is the university's own application form (apply.unipv.eu). Duration: no explicit duration stated for this programme on its own page (only generic 'Undergraduate'); 3 years is the standard Italian Laurea triennale value but was not quoted on this page — excluded.

evidence.quote: Language requirements English Students must have a knowledge of the English language corresponding to at least B2 level of the Common European Framework (CEF).
High-school diploma awarded after at least 12 years of documented education

note.fr: Test d'entrée SAT requis ; score minimum 979/1600.
note.en: SAT entry test required; minimum score 979/1600.

evidence.quote: SAT Entry test, non-EU students residing outside Italy who want to compete for a spot must take a SAT general culture test. The minimum score to compete for a spot is ≥ 979/1600.
